description: idena.navarra.es: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idena.navarra.es. Coverage: the area served by idena.navarra.es. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Cartografía 1:1.000. Línea de conducción sin especificar; Instalaciones. Estación de Tratamiento de Agua Potable (ETAP); Instalaciones de la Mancomunidad de Valdizarbe. Estación de Tratamient; Otros elementos. Anotación de hidrante. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
